newsitem.title: UK: Woolwich to raise UK home loans rates.
newsitem.headline: Woolwich to raise UK home loans rates.

text.p: British home loans provider Woolwich Building Society said on Thursday it was increasing its mortgage rates, as well as savers rates, from December 18.
It said its standard variable mortgage rate would increase by 0.3 percentage points to 7.29 percent, while rates for savers would be increased by up to 0.5 percentage points.
The announcement follows similar moves made by other lenders, after a 0.25 percent increase in the British base lending rate in October and last month's national budget.

Abbey National Plc set the ball rolling when it announced on December 2 that it would be raising its highest standard variable mortgage rate by 0.25 percentage points to 7.29 percent from December 18 and its savings rates by up to 0.25 points.
